pose: Angled 3/4 beauty shot resting on the floor plane
visual_description: A heavy-duty shovel with a flat, square-front blade designed for scooping loose rock and dirt off a flat surface. Features a short, reinforced fiberglass shaft with a wide D-grip handle for maximum control when throwing heavy loads of debris. The blade is wide and slightly upturned at the sides to prevent 'handful-sized' spills.

constraints.material: Saturated yellow fiberglass shaft; industrial black steel head.
constraints.logic: Designed for volume; shows the scale of moving massive amounts of overburden.
